how_to_apply: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the RGNAU Teaching Faculty (on contract) Recruitment 2026.
Applications must be submitted online on or before 06-11-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of RGNAU to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the RGNAU Teaching Faculty (on contract) Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 06-11-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of RGNAU to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the RGNAU Teaching Faculty recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the RGNAU Teaching Faculty (on contract) posts is 06-11-2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Teaching Faculty position?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess at least a Master's degree in the relevant discipline or specialization. A Ph.D. is desirable but not mandatory.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Teaching Faculty posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Teaching Faculty (on contract) positions is 40 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Teaching Faculty role?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a salary of Rs. 75,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the RGNAU Teaching Faculty recruitment?
faq.answer: Interested candidates can apply online through the official RGNAU website on or before the last date of application.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for any category of candidates.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Teaching Faculty positions?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve an Interview and Document Verification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is RGNAU/5281/05/ADMIN/506.

faq.question: Q9. Where is Rajiv Gandhi National Aviation University located?
faq.answer: Rajiv Gandhi National Aviation University is located in Fursatganj, Amethi, Uttar Pradesh.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent or contract position?
faq.answer: This is a contract-based recruitment for Teaching Faculty positions.
